title: Best Case Study Writers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a case study writer: what the package should include, customer interviews, approvals, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: A case study shows how a real customer used your product or service and what changed as a result. It is one of the most persuasive types of content for business buyers. Case studies go wrong when results are exaggerated, the customer has not approved the final text, or the story is all about you instead of the customer. This guide helps you publish case studies that are credible and approved.

faq.q: What is the usual structure of a case study?
faq.a: The customer and their situation, the challenge, why they chose you, what was done, and the results, often with a quote from the customer.

faq.q: Does the writer interview the customer?
faq.a: Often, yes. A short interview gives real quotes and details. Arrange it with the customer's permission and share the questions in advance.

faq.q: Do I need the customer's approval?
faq.a: Yes. Always get written approval of the final text, the customer's name, logo and any figures before publishing.

faq.q: What if the customer cannot share numbers?
faq.a: Use what they can share: time saved, quality improvements, a before-and-after description or a strong quote. Never invent figures.
A web page, a PDF for sales teams and a short version for social media. Some case studies also include a video.
